analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates a festival-inspired half-up pigtail hairstyle using the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush bundle and hair accessories.
analysis.full_description: The video starts with a result-first hook displaying a finished festival hairstyle with bouncy curls and pink hair clips. The creator introduces festival season and announces a tutorial using the Wavytalk Blowout Boost bundle and heat protectant. She shows the boxed product, applies heat protectant, and uses the orange thermal round brush to smooth and curl sections of hair for volume and bounce. She then sections out face-framing strands, ties two high half-up pigtails, curls the front strands with the Blowout Boost brush, wraps hair around the elastics with bobby pins, and adds hair accessories (pink flat clips and a heart clip). The video concludes with the creator showcasing the final look from various angles, holding up the Blowout Boost styling tool, and recommending the VIP volume bundle.

analysis.transcript_full_original: Festival season is finally here and I'm going to show you how to do this hairstyle. I'm using Wavytalk's Blowout Boost bundle and their heat protectant. First thing we're going to do is use the Blowout Boost. Basically we're just going to smooth out the hair and give it some gorgeous curls and lots of volume. I'm going to do this all around my head before we start the hairstyle, and once it's done, we can start sectioning off our face-framing pieces. For this look, we are going to be doing a half up, half down with a pigtail on each side. Once I had the ponytails secure, I just curled my front pieces and cleaned up my part. Next thing you're going to do is grab a section of hair from your ponytail and you're just going to wrap it around the hair tie and bobby pin it into place. I feel like this really ties the look together, but we're going to go a little bit further and add some accessories. All I did was add two clips to one side and this cute little heart-shaped clip to the other side. So if you have been looking for some inspo for your festival hairstyle, I definitely recommend you try this hairstyle out, and get festival ready with Wavytalk's limited edition VIP volume bundle. I promise you, you will not be disappointed, and you definitely do not want to miss out.
